items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: Allen and Sidney Dazby used to play with old man Allen brass band.

ctx.x: He made a record called Biffley Blues.

I never knew what that meant. That's how they called him over in Algiers. All them boys he raised. Allen and Sidney Dazby used to play with old man Allen brass band. Did you ever play in old man Allen's band? Sure. I got all this on the paper but I couldn't get to it before he was coming. That was my first out in the street. Old man Allen. I was playing right there with my brother. My brother Remus. He was playing the bass drum. I played the snare drum. Old man Joe Howe and all of us. Yeah. Papa Celestine was…
